decisions.rationale: ROOT-IM reproduced this in fresh candidate and A1/A2 Windows worktrees: Git's CRLF checkout conversion changes all four sealed seed-file bytes while the manifest correctly names canonical LF bytes. AcceptanceBroker therefore cannot materialize any target. The smallest robust repair is a seed-only Git EOL rule that preserves exact LF bytes in every fresh worktree; changing hashes to one platform's converted bytes or weakening validation would break portability/provenance. The product impact is total S2/C3 target-entrypoint failure, while the fix is one scoped attribute rule plus the already-authored focused test rerun.
decisions.smallest_fix: Add a repository attribute limited to firmware_acceptance/seed/* that enforces LF working-tree bytes, preserve the existing canonical manifest digests, verify a fresh worktree materializes those exact bytes, and rerun only the affected A1/A2 seed/broker tests.
